paper_title: NASDUCK: New Constraints on Axion-like Dark Matter from Floquet Quantum Detector
notes: NASDUCK Floquet detector (129Xe + Rb magnetometer) constrains ALP-neutron coupling over mDM = 4e-15 to 4e-12 eV/c2. Primary result is ALP-neutron (g_aNN); the paper also casts model-dependent ALP-proton bounds and quadratic-coupling bounds. Coupling is reported in GeV^-1 (derivative coupling g_aNN = C_N/f_a), NOT the dimensionless g_an convention, so downstream canonicalization must convert.
